posts.title: WH40K:RP
posts.edited: Last Edit: June 14, 2009, 10:52:27 AM by Brainmurders -{TRF}-
posts.html:
I've been planning for a while to venture into making a new form of RP, and last week a great idea hit me (If you're unfamiliar with the warhammer 40k universe, alot of this will go right over your head).

The basic map is a huge bunker, controlled by the imperial guard; it man's last bastion of defense on the current planet, sandwiched between ravaged cities and mountainous terrain. The standard 'citizen' calss is that of an imperial guardsman conscript, whoes daily duites includes marching drill, light and heavy firearms practice and serving officers. Advancement through the ranks would be determined by officers, who themselves became officers by serving well enough to be picked out by a super admin for promotion. The 'Police Officers' are imperial inquisitors, yet again hand picked by admins to dispense law among the guardsmen.

In the ways of events, I have several in mind. The guardmen could be assembled then the map changed to the afforementioned cities or wilderness, where the men would fight against a combination of themed NPCs and trusted friends playing as the imperium's enmies; necrons, chaos cults etc. More events would include raids on the bunker itself, heretic purges where players who have joined secretive chaos cults are hunted down, and parades.

I believe that the ideas above can be achieved easily enough. I'll be searching websites for appropriate models and weapons, which when added to custom classes on a base RP game mode will make the needed classes.

I'm pretty new to LUA, and may need help with mapping and possibly moddeling; with no help I'd take ages to learn everything then get going with it. I was wondering if anyone with experiance to help with LUA, moddeling and mapping here woudl be interested in helping me.

Thanks  [image not archived: Grin]

Edit: Also, what gamemode should I build it on top of?

posts.author: TJjokerR
posts.title: Re: WH40K:RP
posts.html:
This is what you should do first for your gamemode:
- Get a basic layout of what functions you will have in the gamemode.
- Give more details, maybe I can help you with bits of the coding
- Make nice and efficient system(Like cider has, ex:
Code:
RegisteredItems = {}
function GM.ItemRegister(item)
   RegisteredItems[item.UniqueID] = item
end

-- You would add an item like this:
ITEM = {}

ITEM.UniqueID = "ExampleItem"
ITEM.Name = "Example Item"
ITEM.Costs = 10000

GM.ItemRegister(ITEM)

-- Then you can easily make a shop and add all items with a loop :D
